findings.message: `(mem/length @entity.block ...)` uses a handle that `mem/free`, `mem/arena-drop` or `mem/release` already ended on some path to this transition
findings.suggestion: Stop using the handle after it is freed, dropped or released, or rebind the field from a fresh allocation first

findings.message: `(mem/free @entity.block)` ends a handle that `mem/free`, `mem/arena-drop` or `mem/release` already ended on some path to this transition
findings.suggestion: End each handle once on every path, or set the field to a new handle between the two

findings.message: `(mem/borrow @entity.block "shared")` borrows a block that another borrow of it (an exclusive one, or any when this one is exclusive) still holds on some path to this transition
findings.suggestion: `mem/release` the earlier borrow before borrowing again

findings.message: The arena stored in '@entity.arena' can reach the resting state(s) 'idle' without `mem/arena-drop`
findings.suggestion: Drop the arena on every path to a resting state, including the failure routes

cases.id: the lint input without LINT_SITES is one error finding

findings.message: the lint input arrived without LINT_SITES, so this rule cannot check the program
findings.suggestion: std-orb-lint-input sends LINT_SITES before LINT_INPUT; this rule did not hear it
